message.content: {"note_claim": "The video from 2016 shows people retrieving gifts from a climbable Christmas tree in Cairo's Mall of Arabia, not Muslims vandalizing one in a town square.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "the depicted trees were \"climbable\" and observed that the \"angry Muslims\" were actually revelers who wore Christmas hats, appeared to be in good spirits, and were retrieving gifts placed at the top of the tree for kids to find", "reason": "The Snopes page directly confirms the video was filmed at Cairo's Mall of Arabia and shows people retrieving gifts from a climbable tree, not attacking it."}
